forms.title: OpenClaw Bridge
forms.description: Operator-level settings for the Nextcloud OpenClaw bridge.

fields.title: OpenClaw gateway base URL
fields.description: HTTP base URL for the OpenClaw gateway service.

fields.title: Gateway auth is token based
fields.description: Enable bearer-token auth when calling the OpenClaw gateway.

fields.title: OpenClaw gateway token
fields.description: Shared gateway token stored as a sensitive app config value.

fields.title: Full OpenClaw control UI URL
fields.description: Optional direct URL for opening the full OpenClaw control surface.

fields.title: Gateway transport
fields.description: Transport used for OpenClaw gateway chat traffic.

fields.title: Public OpenClaw WSS URL
fields.description: Optional public WebSocket URL exposed by the OpenClaw gateway.

fields.title: Reverse proxy / WSS public URL
fields.description: Optional reverse-proxy URL used when the gateway is exposed through another endpoint.

fields.title: Chat backend
fields.description: Select whether to prefer OpenClaw, Ollama, or automatic fallback.

fields.title: Enable OpenAI-compatible mode
fields.description: Operator-level compatibility mode. Requests are not isolated per user.

fields.title: Saved outputs folder
fields.description: Relative folder in the user's files where saved responses are uploaded.

fields.title: Safe text MIME types
fields.description: Comma-separated MIME types that may be previewed inline for file context.

forms.title: OpenClaw Bridge
forms.description: Per-user OpenClaw preferences stored in Nextcloud.

fields.title: Send file content from file actions
fields.description: Allow text-like files to send content previews to OpenClaw.

fields.title: Open advanced mode in a new tab
